section-149-1.TO: have due regard to the need to— (a) eliminate discrimination, harassment, victimisation and any other conduct that is prohibited by or under this Act; (b) advance equality of opportunity between persons who share a relevant protected characteristic and persons who do not share it; (c) foster good relations between persons who share a relevant protected characteristic and persons who do not share it

section-149-2.FOR: A person who is not a public authority but who exercises public functions
section-149-2.TO: have due regard to the matters mentioned in subsection (1)
